subject: Kickoff alignment: confirm POC kickoff time, owners & success criteria
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@ormond.tech>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff alignment: confirm POC kickoff time, owners & success criteria

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We want to lock in a 60–90 minute kickoff to align on success criteria, timeline, and owners so the POC runs smoothly. To make scheduling easier, would any of these windows work for your team next week?

- Tue 11/10: 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed 11/11: 13:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 11/12: 08:30–10:00 PT

Attendees we expect: AE (Monica), SE (Dev), Customer Eng lead (Alex), Procurement (Priya if available), and Security representative. If procurement/security need a shorter separate sync, we can schedule that the same week — want to avoid blocking the kickoff for procurement paperwork.

Proposed kickoff agenda (draft):
- Introductions & success criteria (10m)
- POC scope, data and network constraints (20m)
- Demo of integration points (20m)
- Roles, timeline & acceptance criteria (20m)
- Next steps and action items (10m)

Quick ask: please confirm which date/time works and who on your side will be the technical owner and procurement contact. I’ve attached a short draft of POC success criteria and a security preflight checklist for your review.

Thanks —
Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri y o m.das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Confirmed: Wed 11/11 13:00–14:30 PT — POC kickoff & preflight items

Hi everyone —

Confirming Wed, November 11th, 13:00–14:30 PT for the POC kickoff. Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234

Brief agenda (confirmed):
- Intros & primary success criteria (Priyom / Alex) — 10m
- Integration constraints & security checklist review (Dev / Samir / Security) — 30m
- Demo of integration pattern and test plan (Dev) — 25m
- Roles, acceptance tests & timeline (Monica / Samir) — 15m
- Action items & next steps (All) — 10m

POC success criteria (summary):
- Model latency under 200ms median for 1k qps synthetic load (Dev / Ormond eng to validate)
- End-to-end integration of customer SDK and auth within 3 business days of kickoff (Samir owner)
- Security sign-off on data flows and key management before production commit (security@ormond.tech)
- Procurement completes SOW signature or covers contractual gating items within 10 business days (Priya owner)

Owners assigned:
- Customer technical owner: Samir Khatri (samir.khatri@ormond.tech)
- Procurement: Priya Rao (procurement@ormond.tech)
- Redwood AE: Monica Patel
- Redwood SE: Dev Patel
- Redwood Ops escalation: Sean Gallagher

Next steps (before Wed):
1) Dev will share the annotated security checklist (attached).
2) Priya to confirm if procurement requires a separate pre-kickoff contract review (Fri 11/13 if needed).
3) Alex/Samir to confirm any additional test data constraints.

If anyone needs the kickoff shortened to 45 minutes and to push deeper security/commercial items to separate calls, let us know by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks all — looking forward to getting started.

—Priyom
